messages:
alex: kicking off SFO GPU account + VPC scaffold. Target is 3 A100 nodes, public/private subnets, and peered access to infra-shared-services.

mira: thanks — are we using a single project per cluster or shared project with folders?

alex: per our new standard, one project per cluster for billing isolation. folder: `sfo-gpu` under prod org.

raj: quick notes from quota side — GCP currently has A100 quota limit in SFO. I filed a quota increase with GCP (case 12345). Expect 24-48h. If delayed we may fallback to T4 for initial smoke.

joanne: network CIDR plan: VPC `10.40.0.0/16` with three private subnets `/22` across 3 AZs and a small public `/28` for bastion and NAT. Need to confirm no overlap with partner peering (partner uses 10.40.128.0/17).

kelly: tagging & org policy: each resource needs `env`, `team`, `cost-center`. Also enable VPC Flow Logs and private GKE (if we use it).

alex: terraform workspace name `sfo-gpu-cluster-prod`. I'll push a minimal scaffold in the infra repo under `regions/sfo/gpu`. cc @mira for IAM roles.

mira: IAM checklist: service account with roles compute.admin (scoped), kms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for disk encryption, and monitoring.viewer. Lock down instance metadata.

raj: a few gotchas — cloud NAT egress IPs must be in the same region for some vendor IP allowlists. Also pre-create reserved IPs if partner needs stable egress.

joanne: firewall rules: allow internal pod <-> infra-shared-services on 10.20.0.0/16, block 0.0.0.0/0 inbound to private subnets. Bastion only via org SSO.

alex: adding smoke test runbook in thread: after terraform apply run: 1) ssh to bastion, 2) curl metadata service from node, 3) run `nvidia-smi` on an instance, 4) schedule small inference job to verify GPU and MKL libs.

mira: terraform snippet for subnets I pushed to PR #458, sample below:

```hcl
resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "private" {
  name          = "sfo-private-${count.index}"
  ip_cidr_range = cidrsubnet(var.vpc_cidr, 8, count.index)
  region        = var.region
  network       = google_compute_network.vpc.self_link
}
```

raj: cost note: A100 sustained usage ~ $3.2/hr per card + local SSDs. We should enable preemptible variant for non-critical batch to save ~60%. Put a tag `workload: batch` for autoscaler policies.

kelly: compliance: bring-up needs KMS key policy review, and logging exported to retention bucket `org-logs-prod` with 1y retention.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist reminder — please mark items as done in the handoff doc: https://internal.redwood/handbook/region-onboard (bot reaction :white_check_mark:).

joanne: handoff steps proposal: 1) confirm quotas, 2) terraform apply scaffold, 3) run smoke tests, 4) create cluster images & bootstrap AMI, 5) DR test (reboot nodes), 6) cost sanity check, 7) handoff to platform-ops with runbook.

alex: timeline — aiming for quota + infra apply by EOD Friday. If quota pending, we'll do the network + IAM roll and mark GPUs as pending.

mira: i'll own the IAM PR review and post-apply verification. raj can you follow quota ticket and update here?

raj: on it. I pinged GCP rep; will escalate if no response in 24h.

kelly: once smoke passes i'll run a quick cost projection and post numbers here.

alex: perfect. tagging @platform-ops for awareness. any blockers?

platform-ops: platform-ops: FYI — we'll want the terraform state in the prod SA and a retention policy. prepare a README for oncall runbook.

alex: noted. thanks all. I'll drop the PR link when it's ready and move the checklist to the handoff doc. :rocket:
